current.text: Experts rate him a top 2 to 4 pick in 9-cat leagues and are fine taking him at pick 2 or 3. One expert would still take Luka Doncic over him at pick 3 about 75% of the time.
In an auction mock, Josh would not pay more than 60 USD for him. He went for 68 USD.
He ranks higher in category leagues than in points leagues because of his efficiency. In points leagues experts put him behind Doncic, Jokic and Wembanyama.
Late last season his scoring, three-point shooting and minutes all dropped off.
OKC traded away the shooters Lu Dort, Isaiah Joe and Aaron Wiggins and must give more minutes to Ajay Mitchell and Jared McCain.
Reports say he will do more off-ball work. He did some of that for Team Canada.

One expert expects him to take more threes with the shooters gone, so his FG% should fall from about 55% to about 52%. He also expects fewer assists next to Wallace and Mitchell, not above six per game, and is a little soft on him this season.
He is projected at about 33% usage and 33 minutes per game.
OKC plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks with the March 28 end. That is better than Doncic's schedule.
OKC is projected for about 57 to 62 wins and should be a top two seed in the West.
Yahoo lists him as point guard only, which is G in our league.

durable.text: He is a back-to-back MVP. He has improved every year, including a big playmaking leap last season.
He takes few threes. He is elite at contested mid-range jumpers.
He is a league outlier in FG%, FT%, points and steals. His FG% and FT% come on high volume, so he lifts both team ratios clearly.
Rebounds, blocks and threes are his weakest categories, but none of them is weak for a guard.
He has stayed healthy the last couple of years.
Experts call his old injury concerns overblown and see him as a safe pick.

note: He is a top 4 pick in 9-cat who helps every build. He is a league outlier in FG%, FT%, points and steals, and he has no weak category. Prices: Yahoo average cost is 66.8 USD and ESPN is 73.2 USD, against 81 USD in our league last season, while Josh caps him at 60 USD. That suggests he could cost more than his 58 to 64 USD site values, so set a ceiling near 70 USD. Early in the season, watch whether the reported off-ball role shows up. It could mean more threes, an FG% closer to 52% and assists under six.
